purpose: Exact, stable GitHub check names that branch protection MUST require on the default branch. Validated by tests/test_required_checks.py — renaming a job here or in the workflow fails CI.
branch_protection_blocker: requires repository-admin permission (B-17); not claimable from the repository

required.blocking_rationale: loss is a cross-tenant data breach
a bad migration is not rollback-safe

required.note: consumes build-time env; acceptable because it cannot pass without them and failure is loud

recommended_not_required.reason_not_required: path-filtered; a required check that can skip creates an ambiguous state. The unconditional Architectural Invariants job covers the invariant subset.
path-filtered; owns the manifest drift gate. See gap CI-2.
needs secrets; would block PRs from forks

known_gaps.finding: Unpinned third-party actions on MUTABLE refs: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main, superfly/flyctl-actions/setup-flyctl@master, dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
known_gaps.risk: a compromised upstream executes in CI with repository access on the next run

known_gaps.finding: The generated-manifest drift gate lives in the path-filtered worker job, so it only runs when apps/ingestion-worker/** or the manifest changes
known_gaps.mitigation: the manifest path is already in the worker filter; a change to the Python READER is covered by test-core-api

known_gaps.finding: ci.yml and security-audit.yml declare no top-level permissions, inheriting the repository default
known_gaps.risk: GITHUB_TOKEN may hold write scopes no job needs

known_gaps.finding: No worker (cargo) test job runs unconditionally; worker tests are path-filtered only
known_gaps.risk: a change outside apps/ingestion-worker that invalidates a worker assumption is not caught

known_gaps.finding: Deploy jobs are correctly gated to push+main and are not required checks

admin_instructions.note: REPOSITORY ADMIN ONLY. Not performed; branch_protection_active remains false.
steps: Settings → Branches → Branch protection rules → main
Enable 'Require status checks to pass before merging'
Enable 'Require branches to be up to date before merging'
Add each name in required[] EXACTLY as written in the 'check' field
Do NOT add any name from recommended_not_required[] — those can legitimately skip
Verify by opening a PR that touches apps/lifenavigator-core-api and confirming all required checks appear
